trigger: Release from the trunk line or a regulated rural gathering line that caused death or hospitalization, fire or explosion, over $50,000 damage, water pollution, or that the operator judges significant

obligation: Pipeline emergency notices to public officials

notify: 9-1-1 center or local emergency coordinating agency; fire, police, and other public officials
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - trunk line and gathering systems

obligation: State pipeline safety agency incident notice

trigger: Release or incident on the intrastate trunk line
deadline: Varies by state; confirm with the Pipeline Compliance Manager before use

source_url: n/a (state rules vary; confirm with the state agency)

trigger: Discharge of oil that violates water quality standards or causes a sheen, discoloration, sludge, or emulsion on water or adjoining shorelines (for example, a tank overflow after alarms are lost)
deadline: Immediately, as soon as the person in charge has knowledge of the discharge
notify: National Response Center (800-424-8802); if not practicable, the EPA or Coast Guard On-Scene Coordinator
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - production facilities, pipelines, plants, and trucks

deadline: Varies by state; confirm before use

source_url: n/a (state rules vary; confirm with each state regulator)

obligation: E-ISAC notice of a Reportable Cyber Security Incident (low impact)
trigger: The CIP Senior Manager determines that a Cyber Security Incident compromised or disrupted a low impact BES Cyber System at P1, P2, P3, or the GCC (NERC Glossary definition)
deadline: CIP-003-9 sets no fixed time: determination, then notification unless prohibited by law. Company target: within 1 hour of the determination (POL-03)
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - low impact BES Cyber Systems at four assets
notifying_entity: Power Generation (CIP Senior Manager determines; NERC Compliance Manager notifies)
clock_starts: Determination that the incident is reportable

citation: NERC EOP-004-4 R2 and Attachment 1 (GO and GOP events)
trigger: Damage or destruction of its Facility from actual or suspected intentional human action; physical threat to its Facility or suspicious device or activity at its Facility. (Loss of monitoring or control at a BES control center is a reporting event only for RC, BA, and TOP, not for a GOP)
deadline: By the later of 24 hours after recognizing the threshold was met or the end of the next business day (4 p.m. local time)
notify: NERC (systemawareness@nerc.net or 404-446-9780) and the parties in the Operating Plan; a DOE-417 form may be used

notifying_entity: Power Generation (GCC shift lead informs the Balancing Authority)

trigger: Reportable Cyber Security Incidents and attempts involving high or medium impact BES Cyber Systems
deadline: Within 1 hour of determination (for high and medium impact systems only)
applies_at_this_tier: No - the division has low impact BES Cyber Systems only

obligation: Market operator and Balancing Authority notices of unit or Control Center status

trigger: Units unavailable or GCC isolated from normal communications

source_url: n/a (market rules vary; confirm with each market operator)

trigger: During transport, loading, unloading, or temporary storage of crude: a death or hospitalization, public evacuation of 1 hour or more, a major artery closed 1 hour or more, or a situation the person in possession judges should be reported
deadline: As soon as practical but no later than 12 hours after the occurrence
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - crude trucking
notifying_entity: Crude Logistics (dispatch with the Fleet Safety Director)

trigger: Any 171.15 incident, any unintentional release, or structural damage to a cargo tank of 1,000 gallons or more
deadline: Within 30 days of discovery (DOT Form F 5800.1); keep a copy 2 years
notify: PHMSA Office of Hazardous Materials Safety
applies_at_this_tier: Yes - crude trucking
